title: Mintkey AuditEvent
description:
Append-only audit event emitted by every Mintkey container on every state change or auditable action. Discriminated by `event_type`. Common envelope is shared across all event types; per-event payload schemas are pinned per `event_type`.

Stability tier: experimental.

envelope.description: Fields common to every audit event.

request_id.description: Optional ULID identifying the request that produced this event.

trace_id.description: Optional W3C trace-id for cross-service correlation.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous audit event in the tenant's chain (tamper-evidence).

hash.description: Hash of this event over `prev_hash || event_id || event_type || at || payload`.

cascade_count.description: Counts of cascaded resources purged with the tenant. Per ADR-0016.7.

openapi_url.description: URL to the service's OpenAPI document, if any.

ev_credential_registered.description: First credential registration on a brand-new service (no prior version).

ev_credential_rotated.description: A new credential `key_version` superseded the previous one.

ev_agent_created.description: Agent was created. Payload carries the API key fingerprint, NOT the plaintext key.

api_key_fingerprint.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the Agent API Key. Plaintext key never appears in audit.

constraints.description: ABAC constraints, closed schema per ADR-0016.4.

rate_limit.description: Per-agent rate limit on this (service, action) tuple.

time_window.description: Time-of-day window the permission is valid in, evaluated in the given IANA timezone.

request_path_prefix.description: Allowed path prefixes within the registered service.

ev_token_issued.description: A brokered JWT was minted by the Credential Broker.

ev_token_denied.description: A `request_token` call was denied by the Credential Broker.

ev_proxy_hit.description: A request flowed through the Egress Proxy. Recorded after the response.

request_path_template.description: Templated path (e.g. `/v1/users/{id}`); raw path is NOT recorded to avoid PII leakage.

ev_proxy_denied.description: A request was denied at the proxy before forwarding (JWT verify/scope/tnt mismatch/revoked).

jti.description: Optional — may be absent if the token was unparseable.

ev_proxy_error.description: A 5xx outcome at the proxy not attributable to denial — backend error, plugin failure, etc.

scope.description: `instance` = shared-KEK rotation; `tenant` = per-tenant KEK rotation (Phase 2 high-isolation tier).

username_attempted.description: Best-effort attempted identifier; do not log passwords.

ev_audit_chain_verified.title: audit.chain.verified
ev_audit_chain_verified.description: Per-tenant audit hash chain successfully verified end to end. Emitted by the verification job.

first_event_id.description: First event in the verified range.

last_event_id.description: Last event in the verified range.

ev_audit_chain_tampered.title: audit.chain.tampered
ev_audit_chain_tampered.description: Per-tenant audit hash chain found inconsistent. Emitted by the verification job. Triggers operator alarm.

ev_settings_updated.title: settings.updated
ev_settings_updated.description: Admin-level settings changed (internal_auth, oidc, audit retention, etc.). Per ADR-0016.6.

ev_platform_admin_access.title: platform_admin.access
ev_platform_admin_access.description: PlatformAdmin cross-tenant read access (audit query, changes feed, list endpoints). Per ADR-0017.4.

viewed_tenant_ids.description: Empty array or ["__all__"] when reading across all tenants.

endpoint.description: Canonical OpenAPI operationId of the read.

ev_service_test_executed.title: service.test_executed
ev_service_test_executed.description: Operator clicked the Test button on a service; the broker invoked the registered backend with the current credential. Per F-OP-03.

status_code.description: 0 if no HTTP response was received.

ok.description: True iff status_code is 2xx and no transport error.

error.description: Transport error category if not ok (e.g., timeout, dns_failure, tls_failure).

ev_tenant_bootstrap_completed.title: tenant.bootstrap_completed
ev_tenant_bootstrap_completed.description: First-time bootstrap of a tenant completed by the seed job. Per F-OP-01.
